DAQ software
HBK DAQ (Data Acquisition) software is a specialized program designed to facilitate the collection, analysis, and visualization of data from various sensors and measurement instruments. It serves as a crucial interface between the hardware components, such as sensors and data acquisition devices, and the user's computer system. DAQ software enables users to configure and control the acquisition process, set parameters, and acquire real-time data. It plays a vital role in industrial automation, scientific research, and engineering applications, providing a user-friendly environment for monitoring and interpreting data for better decision-making.
